name: Evil Nun Rush
storyline: Evil Nun Rush is same as the aforementioned game, but with storyline of William Bismarck of his past and how he lost his leg. The game will have new cutscenes added constantly, more puzzles, and more background knowledge of Sister Madeline in Future Updates. So far, only Chapter 1 is available, but Chapter 2 will be out soon.
summary: Evil Nun Rush is a first-person horror game where players try to avoid capture by a persistent enemy, Sister Madeline, while navigating various levels. The game features 3D environments and audio designed to enhance the atmosphere. Playing with headphones is suggested to better experience the sound design. The game continues the story of the Evil Nun series, focusing on fast-paced gameplay and escape challenges.
